tools.name: get_buying_gauge
tools.description: Current Bitcoin Buying Gauge verdict: a 0-100 score (higher = historically better entry) from 10 weighted market signals (MVRV, Mayer Multiple, Puell Multiple, funding rate, Fear & Greed, price vs 30d MA, realized vol, time patterns, MSTR mNAV), plus the best upcoming entry window. Updated continuously. Methodology: https://galaxymind.space/methodology

tools.name: get_gauge_history
tools.description: Daily Buying Gauge score history (oldest first). Each entry: date, 0-100 score, tier.

days.description: Lookback window in days · snapped to the nearest supported window (30, 90, 180, 365); defaults to 90

tools.name: get_treasuries
tools.description: Live mNAV scoreboard for the major public Bitcoin treasury companies (MSTR/Strategy, XXI/Twenty One, MPJPY/Metaplanet, ASST/Strive). Gross mNAV = market cap ÷ value of BTC held · below 1.0 means the stock trades under the value of its bitcoin. Returns all three valuation lenses from the BTC Prague 2026 debate: grossMNav (common only, ignores capital structure), evMNav (enterprise / fully-diluted · market cap + debt + preferred, Saylor's 'include the notional' lens), and netMNav (CEBE · after senior claims, the conservative common-equity view). Also bps (gross bitcoin per $100 of stock, before claims), cebeBps (after claims), and amplification (bps ÷ cebeBps · 1.0 means no senior leverage, higher means more). CEBE/EV are pending where senior-claims figures are not yet sourced (gross bps is still provided).

tools.name: get_treasury_history
tools.description: Daily mNAV history for one treasury ticker (oldest first).

days.description: Lookback window in days · snapped to the nearest supported window (30, 90, 180, 365); defaults to 90

tools.name: get_bitcoin_float
tools.description: The Bitcoin float: how much BTC is realistically left to buy. In-play supply = mined supply minus long-term-lost, government-seized, spot-ETF, and public-treasury coins, plus the full cohort breakdown.

tools.name: get_halving_countdown
tools.description: Live countdown to the next Bitcoin halving: blocks remaining, estimated days and month, and the block-subsidy change.

tools.name: get_bitcoin_price
tools.description: Live Bitcoin spot price in USD with an asOf timestamp. Prefer this over training data for any current-price claim. When the upstream feed is down the price is null and degraded is true; a null is never replaced with a stale or estimated value.

tools.name: get_yield_leaderboard
tools.description: US-listed bitcoin-treasury perpetual preferreds (Strategy STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD; Strive SATA, SATS) ranked by effective yield (annual dividend ÷ price) on the latest delayed print. Each row has rank, rank change since the prior session, dividend rate, frequency, next cash event and total return (price change plus dividends) against bitcoin over the chosen timeframe. Includes the #1 streak, unranked names with the reason, methodology and asOf. A sort, not a recommendation.

timeframe.description: Window for the total-return comparison with bitcoin. Default 3M.

tools.name: get_pref
tools.description: One bitcoin-treasury preferred by ticker: cited terms (stated amount, rate with its filing and as-of date, cumulative or not, frequency, seniority, shares), the latest delayed print, effective yield, cash payback, leaderboard rank and rank change, next cash event, and total return against bitcoin for 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y and since IPO. Windows without sourced data come back as named gaps.

ticker.description: STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD, SATA or SATS

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Search the human-verified directory of merchants that accept native Bitcoin (on-chain + Lightning) for everyday goods. Each listing carries its verification date, is monitored automatically every day, and is flagged `stale` only if no human has confirmed it in 180 days; the response reports how many matches are stale. Each row carries a unique `slug`; one handle may run several shops, listed in `siblings`. Filter by free-text query, category, or country.

query.description: Free-text match on name, handle, and description

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: Look up a Bitcoin/treasury metric definition from the Galaxy Mind glossary (mNAV, MVRV, Puell Multiple, in-play supply, accretion, …). Definitions are standalone and written to be quoted with attribution.

term.description: Term name or slug, e.g. 'mNAV' or 'puell-multiple'

tools.name: get_hashrate_market
tools.description: Live SHA256 AsicBoost hashrate rental market. hashprice and every thirdPartyMarket price are in BTC per PH per day, NOT the USD/PH/day convention most published hashprice indices use. networkPhs is raw network hashrate in PH/s. thirdPartyMarket.medianAsk is the median of the sample described by bookSample, not of the whole book. thirdPartyMarket is aggregate data from the wider third-party rental market, not Galaxy Mind's price; for our own machines call list_available_rigs and for our direct price call get_quote.

tools.name: list_available_rigs
tools.description: Direct rentals from Galaxy Mind have closed, so there is no bay board here. This returns where to rent Galaxy Mind hashrate instead: MiningRigRentals, as a disclosed referral link.

tools.name: get_rental_quote
tools.description: Direct rentals from Galaxy Mind have closed. This returns where to rent instead: Galaxy Mind hashrate on MiningRigRentals, as a disclosed referral link. It gives no price and places no order.

rigs.description: Number of whole S21 XP rigs (270 TH each), 1 to 4 per order. Defaults to 1.

ph.description: Alternatively, the hashrate wanted in PH/s, up to 1.08. 270 TH minimum; rounded to whole rigs. Overrides rigs.

days.description: Rental length in whole days, 1 to 7 during the pilot. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: rental_status
tools.description: Status of a Galaxy Mind rental by its private access code: the code from the browser checkout (galaxymind.space/hashrate/rent), from create_rental, or from Galaxy Mind support. Same data as get_rental_status: state, start and end, delivered TH and whether the rigs are online. Returns no personal data.

access_code.description: The private access code issued when the rental was paid.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Direct rentals from Galaxy Mind have closed. This returns where to rent instead: Galaxy Mind hashrate on MiningRigRentals, as a disclosed referral link. It gives no price and places no order.

tools.name: get_rental_status
tools.description: Same data as rental_status (which takes the access code instead): rental state, start and end times, and delivered TH reported by the rigs. awaitingPoolApproval=true while a custom pool waits for manual approval (up to 2 hours, refunded if not approved); rejectedReason names why a pool was refused (refund queued). Needs rental_id and creator_secret. Not read-only: while unpaid it re-checks the payment, which can start the rental or queue a refund, and it re-sends a stalled pool switch.

creator_secret.description: creatorSecret from create_rental. Shown once; keep it private.
